Intensity_A: Total fluorescence intensity for replicate A
Intensity_B: Total fluorescence intensity for replicate B
Z-score_A: Z-score for replicate A, calculated using experimental well plate average FI and standard deviation
Z-score_B: Z-score for replicate B, calculated using experimental well plate average FI and standard deviation
Auto-fluorescent: Indicates whether a compound was considered auto-fluorescent (AF), based on the well total fluorescence intensity
